note: Time ranges are typical, not guaranteed. Licensing steps follow the Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners.

levels.title: Helper
levels.focus: Site safety, tools and materials. Learns by assisting and keeps a job moving.

levels.title: Apprentice I
levels.focus: Registered apprentice. Basic rough-in and repair tasks under direct supervision.

levels.title: Apprentice II
levels.focus: Completes common repairs and installs with checks. Reads plans. Starts recording readings.

levels.title: Apprentice III
levels.focus: Runs routine jobs with a journeyman on call. Prepares for the journeyman exam.

levels.title: Journeyman
levels.focus: Licensed. Works independently and owns a job from diagnosis to close, paperwork included.

levels.title: Senior Journeyman
levels.focus: Takes the difficult diagnoses. Trains an apprentice. Logs before and after readings as routine.

levels.title: Lead
levels.focus: Runs a crew and a schedule. Answers for quality and callbacks across several jobs.

levels.title: Systems Plumber
levels.focus: Designs and commissions whole systems. Writes field notes. Works on water systems testing.

levels.title: Master / Technical Lead
levels.focus: Master license. Sets standards, reviews designs and owns the technical direction, including this ladder.
